name: Rikhav Securities Ltd
title: Rikhav Securities Ltd - 544340 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Weak H2 FY26 with PAT of INR1.20 crore and EBITDA of INR6.57 crore after cash-market share losses of INR20-23 crore; management guides FY27 brokerage growth of about 20% and offers little new capacity-discipline evidence.

triggers.label: Cash-market investment cut by INR50 crore
triggers.quote: we have reduced the investment in shares to the extent of INR50 crores and we planning to reduce investment in shares of another INR50 crores

triggers.label: Retail and HNI brokerage slack for six months
triggers.quote: retail and HNI also, there is a slack in the market, so it is a very difficult to improve the brokerage in the last six months

triggers.label: FY27 brokerage growth about 20%
triggers.quote: We expect around 20% growth in brokerage and the cliental and around 20% to 25% growth in the algo trading and delta hedging income

triggers.label: FY27 revenue about INR40 crore
triggers.quote: March 27, it is a full year around INR40 crores

guidance.metric: FY27 algo trading and delta hedging income growth

guidance.value: not more than INR50 crores this year

red_flags.label: Cash-market share losses INR20-23 crore
red_flags.quote: loss from cash market shares of old investment, to be amounting to around INR20 crores to INR23 crores

red_flags.label: Unrecognised SLBM profit INR4.33 crore
red_flags.quote: unrealized profit of INR4.33 crores from SLBM transactions has not been recognized in financial statements

red_flags.label: Inconsistent revenue explanations, evasive on questions
red_flags.quote: You send me this query specifically via email, I will reply to you in writing.
